name: status-banner
description: One status banner above the prompt: plan usage, the session's turn, speed, cost, cache countdown with a Keep warm button and context fill, a goal and next-step summary, and a heads-up after long turns.

keepWarmHours.title: Keep-warm window (hours)
keepWarmHours.description: How long one press of Keep warm keeps the prompt cache warm.

cacheLifetime.title: Prompt cache lifetime
cacheLifetime.description: 1h for subscriptions (the default). 5m for API-key and cloud-provider sessions.

summaryRow.title: Summary row
summaryRow.description: Goal, next step and what waits on you, from one Haiku call after each turn.

headsUp.title: Heads-up
headsUp.description: After a long turn, one Haiku call flags up to two things you might miss.
